transcript: Well I think an important piece of this and again I'll go back to the Agriculture Committee hearing that we just had where we heard from the president of the Farm Bureau talking about the robust farm bill that he wants to see us put through that includes all of our support for crop insurance and protecting first generation farmers and certainly our commodities programs that are so incredibly vital and some of the rural development programs, et cetera, et cetera, and also called out by name the importance of the nutrition programs are part of this larger substantial piece of legislation. The ability to have kids not have a stigma attached to needing support because their family had fallen on hard times. That was incredibly important within the school district. And so, I'm working with GT Thompson, who's leading this legislation, and I'm co-leading it. to change that. So if, you know, in a school lunch program, we want to ensure that the healthiest option of, you know, nutrient-rich whole milk that we know generally, a lot of kids prefer whole milk to any of the reduced fat varieties is available to them. In this case, it's, you know, elementary school kids that, you know, a lot of them want whole milk.
